item.tib: ma cig srid pa rgyal mo'i gsang bskang bzlog bsad mdos kyi mngon rtogs byin rlabs
item.coloph: ye shes mkha' 'gro'i lung bzhin du/ nges med rnal 'byor bdag gis bkod/ nyes 'gal byung srid lha la bshags/ dge mchis sems can don du bsngo/ sangs rgyas thob pa'i rgyu gyur cig sa ma ya/ rgya rgya rgya//
